answer.reason: The verses tell of Baasha's fortifying of Ramah, his destruction of Jeroboam's house, and the LORD's word against his house, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: built Ramah to keep anyone from going out or in to Asa
clauses.quote: built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah

clauses.english: destroyed all the house of Jeroboam
clauses.quote: he smote all the house of Jeroboam

clauses.english: was told by the LORD through Jehu that his house would be taken away
clauses.quote: I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house

doubts: 1KI 21:22, 2KI 9:9 and JER 41:9 mention Baasha only as a comparison or in passing, so they were not used.
His leaving off Ramah and Zimri's destruction of his house were omitted as less central events.
